invariants_to_lock: System MUST fail-closed with immediate error propagation and zero stale state.
option_a.title: Archetype Alpha (Conservative / Fail-Closed)
option_a.tradeoff_con: Lower throughput under transient faults, operations fail immediately on first error.
option_a.tradeoff_pro: Strict validation, immediate error propagation, synchronous verification, high security, zero stale data allowance.

invariants_to_lock: System MUST allow optimistic execution with 30s grace windows and asynchronous fallback buffers.
option_b.title: Archetype Beta (Resilient / High-Throughput)
option_b.tradeoff_con: Potential temporary state divergence and delayed consistency resolution.
option_b.tradeoff_pro: Grace windows, optimistic concurrency, asynchronous worker processing, fallback buffers, eventually consistent state.

locked_invariants: System MUST fail-closed with immediate error propagation and zero stale state.
